title: Ultrascan
category: Social Media Design • Outdoor Advertising • Editorial Design • Stationery • Print Design
description: Ultrascan is a medical and diagnostic brand for which a wide range of visual communication materials was developed. The project focused on creating consistent and engaging designs for social media, outdoor advertising, certificates, educational books, vehicle branding, and stationery. The visual system uses a bold yellow, red, white, and dark navy palette to create a recognizable and energetic communication style across different applications.
challenge: The design problem was one consistent look across very different formats: social media, billboards, vehicle graphics, certificates, books and stationery, while presenting medical information in an accessible way.
solution: A comprehensive set of branded communication materials was developed using a consistent visual language centered around strong yellow backgrounds, red accents, white typography, dark navy elements, medical imagery, and prominent promotional compositions. The work included a large set of social media designs covering educational, promotional, seasonal, and informational content. Outdoor applications included billboard designs and full vehicle branding. Professional certificate designs were created for medical and educational purposes, while books were designed across both covers and interior pages for subjects such as fetal echocardiography and gynecology. The identity was further extended into branded stationery and additional printed communication materials, creating a unified visual presence across both digital and physical touchpoints.
results: The work delivers a visual system applied across social media, advertising, educational books, vehicle branding, certificates and stationery, built on a strong colour palette, clear information hierarchy, medical imagery and repeatable graphic elements.
